run_gaia2_upload: run the GAIA2 upload script to upload benchmark results to HuggingFace and generate report statistics
reconstruct_results_from_output_dir: reconstruct MultiScenarioValidationResult objects from a GAIA2 output directory containing JSONL results and trace files
parse_jsonl_results: parse a JSONL results file and return a list of dictionaries with scenario metadata
create_scenario_validation_result: create a ScenarioValidationResult from a JSONL entry dict and optional trace data string
load_trace_file: load trace data from a JSON file at the given path and return its contents as a string
